messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: we have mc-stan.org
parts:
I just registered the domain for 5 years with
pairNIC.com and signed up for a year of site hosting
with pair.com. (I chose those because they were
recommended by a friend I trust as having good uptime, speed,
and service and being easy to use [ftp and ssh] and relatively
inexpensive [$10/month]. There is a bewildering slew of options
out there.)

Does anyone (other than Malecki and Daniel) want the pwd
and upload info? And if so, do you mind if I e-mail them
rather than printing them on self-destructing paper?

- Bob
